items.source: A type does not need to be annotated at class level to be candidate, and this performs a "deep scan" by loading every class in the target packages and search for Reflective on types, constructors, methods, and fields. Enclosed classes are candidates as well. Classes that fail to load are ignored.
items.translation: 类型无需在类级别添加注解即可成为候选项，此操作会执行“深度扫描”，通过加载目标包中的每个类，并在类型、构造函数、方法和字段上搜索 Reflective。内部类也是候选项。无法加载的类将被忽略。

items.source: Allows for more concise annotation declarations if no other attributes are needed — for example, @ReflectiveScan("org.my.pkg") instead of @ReflectiveScan(basePackages = "org.my.pkg").
items.translation: 如果不需要其他属性，则允许使用更简洁的注解声明——例如，使用 `@ReflectiveScan("org.my.pkg")` 而不是 `@ReflectiveScan(basePackages = "org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to scan for reflection usage.
items.translation: 用于指定要扫描以查找反射使用情况的包的 `basePackages()` 的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Either basePackageClasses() or basePackages() (or its alias value()) may be specified to define specific packages to scan. If specific packages are not defined, scanning will occur recursively beginning with the package of the class that declares this annotation.
items.translation: 可以指定 `basePackageClasses()` 或 `basePackages()`（或其别名 `value()`）来定义要扫描的特定包。如果未定义特定包，则将从声明此注解的类的包开始递归进行扫描。

items.source: value() is an alias for (and mutually exclusive with) this attribute.
items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名（且与之互斥）。

items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source:
Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package
that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Base packages to scan for reflective usage.
items.translation: 要扫描反射用法的基包。
